description: Semantic probes for TriangleMeshSlicer public contour repair with split facet vertices. Filters are exact Catch case names.

mutants.test_filter: Single-plane slicing closes a box with coincident split triangle vertices
mutants.description: A zero join radius cannot close the triangle-soup section because all triangle vertex indices are split; the public contour count and analytic rectangular area must fail.

mutants.test_filter: Single-plane slicing joins reversed split facets into one contour
mutants.description: The reversed right wall requires the public slicer’s reversed-endpoint close-gap pass to join the rectangle. The test requires one contour with the analytic 20 by 14 footprint and normalized orientation.
